acknowledgement_phrase: I ACKNOWLEDGE ONE BOUNDED BINANCE SPOT TESTNET RESTART AND SOAK CAMPAIGN
startup_policy: Require a zero-order BTCUSDT startup census. Persist an order intent atomically before the sole exchange placement request.
restart_policy: Exit the prepare process with the bounded order resting, then recover it from a separate process using durable state plus the exchange open-order census.
idempotency_policy: A persisted placement request is never submitted again. Restart recovery must resolve the deterministic client order ID through exchange reads.
kill_stop_policy: Persist the kill-stop before cancellation. It blocks every new order-entry path while still allowing reconciliation and cancellation.
reset_policy: A missing tracked order, account drift, or erased order history invalidates the run as a possible Testnet reset. Never recreate the missing order.
soak_policy: Keep the kill-stop enabled for 600 seconds while performing REST heartbeats, authenticated account/order reconciliation, and two forced WebSocket signature-subscription reconnects.
cleanup_policy: Cancel only the deterministic campaign order. Any fill, partial fill, unknown order, balance drift, or unresolved open order fails qualification.
pass_gates: three distinct operating-system processes complete prepare, recover, and soak
startup BTCUSDT open-order census is empty
exactly one bounded resting order is submitted
restart finds exactly one matching open order and performs no duplicate POST
durable kill-stop is enabled before campaign cancellation
a new order attempt is blocked locally while the kill-stop is enabled
tracked order is CANCELED with zero execution and an empty trade ledger
initial and final BTC and USDT account balances match exactly
known canceled order remains queryable throughout the soak
REST heartbeat and reconciliation minimums are met
two forced WebSocket reconnects and three subscriptions succeed
no exchange reset, account drift, open campaign order, or failed gate remains
limitations: Binance Spot Testnet assets and orders are virtual
a ten-minute soak does not prove 24-hour or production reliability
an actual periodic Testnet reset is not induced
reset handling is proven synthetically and monitored fail-closed during the run
adapter qualification does not prove strategy edge or profitable execution
production, live, real-capital, and strategy authority remain false
